decision: Keep shared DesktopCapturer and modular owned-frame wrapper; remove retained decoder frame for both backends
limitations: Same-process generated WGC scene to CPU pixels, not physical display/input latency
Both backends receive timer, encoder scheduling and decoder fixes
Legacy software decoder/shared encoder versus v2 hardware-preferred decoder/per-viewer encoder
Configured bitrate ceilings are equal; measured wire rate and full-color quality are not matched
Two runs per variant; summaries are medians of run percentiles, not pooled percentiles
Capture-only excludes codecs/network; stage RTP associations stay within sender or receiver
Software delivery, four-viewer memory, native handles and field acceptance remain open
